trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum has no task of its own: it unlocks the moment the other 54 trophies are all yours. Treat the trophy list as your checklist and save the easiest clean-up trophies for last so the platinum pops on a satisfying final one.
steps: Earn the other 54 trophies in any order you like.
Open the trophy list to spot anything still missing, then finish it to trigger the platinum.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: The opening mission hands you this trophy for free. Just start a new game and play Gone Fishing through to the end; nothing needs preparing and nothing can go wrong.
steps: Start a new game.
Play the opening mission Gone Fishing to the end.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Keep following the pink main-mission markers through Chapter 1 and this trophy arrives when the chapter closes. Story trophies never lock you out, so there is no side content to worry about here.
steps: Complete every main mission in Chapter 1.
Finish the mission that ends the chapter.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Play through all of Chapter 2's main missions in order; the trophy unlocks as the chapter wraps up. The masked letters are part of the official title exactly as it appears on PlayStation Network.
steps: Complete every main mission in Chapter 2.
Finish the mission that ends the chapter.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Work through Chapter 3's main missions and the trophy pops at the chapter's end. It is purely story-driven, so just stay on the mission path and it will come.
steps: Complete every main mission in Chapter 3.
Finish the mission that ends the chapter.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Clear all the main missions in Chapter 4 and this trophy unlocks when the chapter concludes. The story is nearing its endgame by now, so just keep pushing the main quest line.
steps: Complete every main mission in Chapter 4.
Finish the mission that ends the chapter.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: This gold trophy marks the end of the story and unlocks once the final mission is done. It cannot be missed, and after the credits you return to free-roam, so everything else on the list can be cleaned up afterwards.
steps: Play the story through to the final mission.
Complete the final mission and watch the credits roll.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Breakfast Run is a Chapter 2 story mission, so this trophy unlocks naturally as you play the campaign. No special objective is needed during the mission itself.
steps: Reach Chapter 2 in the story.
Complete the main mission Breakfast Run.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: The Cartel Heist is a Chapter 3 story mission, and finishing it earns this trophy on the spot. There are no optional objectives tied to it, so play the mission however you like.
steps: Reach Chapter 3 in the story.
Complete the main mission The Cartel Heist.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Child's Play is a Chapter 4 story mission, and completing it unlocks this trophy immediately. Like the other mission trophies it needs no extra effort beyond finishing the job.
steps: Reach Chapter 4 in the story.
Complete the main mission Child's Play.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Headliners is a Chapter 4 story mission, and finishing it earns this trophy. The unusual spelling DWNFALL is the official title, confirmed live on the trophy trackers.
steps: Reach Chapter 4 in the story.
Complete the main mission Headliners.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: VCIA Takedown is a Chapter 4 story mission, and this trophy unlocks when you finish it. It is a straightforward story trophy with no hidden conditions.
steps: Reach Chapter 4 in the story.
Complete the main mission VCIA Takedown.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Operation Savage Glory is a Chapter 5 story mission, and completing it unlocks this trophy. It is one of the last mission trophies before the finale, so finish the operation and collect it.
steps: Reach Chapter 5 in the story.
Complete the main mission Operation Savage Glory.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: This is the big one: reach 100% on the in-game completion checklist, which only becomes visible after the story under Progress, then Stats. The checklist is forgiving, closer to 60% true completion, and progress made during the story already counts. Expect it to take the bulk of the roughly 200 hours to platinum, and use the checklist itself as your to-do list.
steps: Finish the story to unlock the 100% Completion Checklist.
Work through the checklist categories until it reads 100%.
Use the in-game tracker to mop up whatever categories remain.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off any 250 of the 397 stunts scattered across Leonida, mixing stunt jumps, flights under bridges, knife flights and base jumps however you like. Flying under bridges tends to be the quickest way to rack them up. Track your total in the Progress menu, and note the 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past this trophy.
steps: Find stunt spots on the map under Exploration, then Stunt Spots.
Complete any 250 stunts across the four categories.
Check Progress, then Activities, then Stunts for your running total.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Sample all nine activity types at least once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a race and performing a stunt. Most of these show up naturally during the story and while working on other trophies. See which types you have done under Progress, then Activities.
steps: Open Progress, then Activities to see the nine activity types.
Try each type once, starting with the ones the story already introduced.
Fill in any missing types by visiting their map icons.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: There are 12 shooting ranges holding 42 challenges in total, and you need a gold medal in every one. Take your time, learn each range's pattern, and retry the ones that give you trouble. All 42 golds are also required for the 100% checklist, so this is not optional work.
steps: Visit the shooting ranges across Leonida.
Earn a gold medal in each of the 42 challenges.
Replay any challenge that falls short of gold until it passes.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win at least one drone race at each of the 14 Top Fun locations, out of 42 races in total. You only need one win per location for this trophy, but the 100% checklist asks for all 42 races, so the extra wins will count later. Learn the course lines and use boosts on the straights.
steps: Find the 14 Top Fun drone race locations on the map.
Win one race at each location.
Keep racing afterwards if you are chasing the 100% checklist too.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races, with each race location counting only once toward the total. There are 40 unique race locations, so you have plenty of choice. Pick the race types you are best at and work through them steadily.
steps: Find race locations on the map.
Win 20 different races, one win per location.
Try a different race type if one keeps beating you.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After you meet Cal in Chapter 1, he will text you about a fishing spot marked on the map. Follow his fishing questline and beat him in the challenge he sets. The spot stays available after the story, so there is no rush.
steps: Meet Cal during the Chapter 1 story.
Wait for his text marking a fishing spot, then go there.
Beat Cal in the fishing challenge.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish all the levels of any one of the four arcade games: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind or Bang For Your Buck. The first three can be played on the TV at home, while the fourth is found at arcade machines around the world. Pick the game you enjoy most and play it through to the end.
steps: Pick one of the four arcade games.
Play through all of its levels to the end.
Retry the levels you fail until you finish the game.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's questline opens in Chapter 3 and is exclusive to Lucia: she calls, then texts you her address in Belville. Work through her five missions, which revolve around the Cellerica chain, and the trophy pops after the last one. Everything stays available after the story.
steps: Play as Lucia in Chapter 3 and wait for Andy's call and text.
Follow the questline to her home in Belville.
Complete all five Andy missions, ending with the finale.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's questline starts in Chapter 1 after you work for him, and it is all about diving for treasure at shipwrecks. He marks treasure sites on your map, and you clear seven shipwrecks in total, returning the finds to his shop in Key Lento. He goes quiet for a while mid-story but always comes back, so the line is never missable.
steps: Start Kenton's line in Chapter 1 and follow his calls and map markers.
Dive each marked shipwreck and bring the treasure back to his shop.
Clear all seven shipwrecks to finish his final mission.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's questline opens after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, marked at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. It runs five jobs long, ending with Hometown Heroes, and every step stays open after the story. Follow the purple markers through his jobs and the trophy lands at the end.
steps: Finish the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break to unlock Billy's line.
Head to the Thrillbilly Mudclub and start his jobs.
Complete all five Billy missions through Hometown Heroes.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish eight full stranger questlines, but note that only certain ones count: Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete are confirmed, while many others such as Moses, Tyrone and Andy do not count toward this total. Check the trophy tracker before and after a strand's final quest to see whether it counted. All qualifying strands remain open after the story.
steps: Find stranger questlines marked on the map and start the confirmed ones.
Complete each strand through its final quest.
Watch the trophy counter and finish eight counting strands.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's line begins after the Chapter 3 mission where you steal the Zorrusso for him, which also unlocks the Key Cloner. He then hands you a wish list of 16 sports cars to steal and deliver to his garage in west Vice City. Deliver them all, in good condition for better pay, and the trophy unlocks with the last car.
steps: Complete the Chapter 3 mission to steal the Zorrusso for Randy.
Check Randy's Wish List under Map, then Robberies.
Steal and deliver all 16 cars on his list.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's line is Jason-only and opens after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty. Head to the Synthetic Labs marked in Vice City and destroy enough of them, then Tyrone hands you the final job, Spin On This, to shut the labs down for good. It all stays available after the story.
steps: Play as Jason and finish the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty.
Destroy the Synthetic Labs marked in Vice City.
Complete Tyrone's final quest, Spin On This.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: There are 18 meditation spots across 10 locations, and meditating with both Jason and Lucia at a spot counts twice. This is the list's only potentially missable trophy: one early meditation at Jason's house in Chapter 1, when Lucia walks to the balcony after the Down to Earth mission, can be lost forever if you skip it. Do that one in Chapter 1, then sweep the other spots after the story using the tracker under Progress, then Collections, then Exploration.
steps: In Chapter 1, after Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning and accept her meditation invitation on the balcony.
Visit all 18 meditation spots and meditate with both characters where possible.
Check Progress, then Collections, then Exploration, then Meditations to confirm every spot is done.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret Vogel's hunting line opens after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when Jason gets a text inviting him to meet Bret in Lummox County. Take the unique hunting rifle he gives you, follow his marked hunting spots, and bring him the animals he requests. Which exact animal triggers the trophy is still being pinned down by the community, so work through his Target Decks and check the latest findings.
steps: Play as Jason after Coffee Break and answer Bret's text to meet him.
Take the hunting rifle from Bret and follow his marked hunting spots.
Hunt the animals he requests and deliver them to him.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: There are 18 card sets holding 480 cards in total, and you only need to complete any three sets for this trophy. Cards turn up all over Leonida, so grab them as you explore and check your collection under Progress. The 100% checklist wants 15 sets, so keep collecting long after this trophy pops.
steps: Pick up collectible cards as you explore Leonida.
Check your sets under Progress, then Collections.
Complete any three full card sets.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK phone app to scan 100 spots around the world: landmarks, curiosities and sculptures all count, and there are far more than 100 to choose from. Just point the app at anything interesting as you travel and scan it. Scanning also feeds the vehicle discovery and 100% work, so make it a habit.
steps: Open the WAiNK app on your phone while out in the world.
Scan landmarks, curiosities and sculptures as you find them.
Keep scanning until the counter reaches 100 locations.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: There are 80 challenges split into eight categories of ten, and you need any 50 of them for this trophy. Most will complete on their own while you chase other trophies, so leave this for late in your run and then pick off the easiest remaining ones. The 100% checklist needs 70, so you will keep going after this pops.
steps: Play normally and let challenges complete while doing other trophies.
Check Progress, then Challenges to see what is done.
Finish the easiest remaining challenges until you reach 50.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Once you can free-roam with your partner after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, call them to your side, build a 4-star wanted level, then escape the red heat zone. A fast bike and the train tunnel north of Ambrosia make the getaway much easier. You will likely earn this on its own while robbing bank vaults, which always bring four stars.
steps: Unlock partner free-roam after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break.
Call your partner to join you, then raise a 4-star wanted level.
Escape the red heat zone on a fast bike until the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, rob three shops in a row while keeping your wanted level active the whole time. Bring armor, sticky bombs and healing items, and hit the shops quickly one after another. The trophy pops about half a minute after you leave the third shop, so do not worry if it is slow to appear.
steps: Call your partner to join you after Coffee Break.
Rob three shops in a row without losing your wanted level.
Keep moving and wait a moment after the third shop for the trophy.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Scan 100 different vehicles with the WAiNK app; you only need to scan them, not drive them. Stand on a busy road and sweep the passing traffic, and the count climbs fast. The 100% checklist wants 200 of the 277 base models, so this trophy falls naturally on the way there.
steps: Open the WAiNK app on your phone.
Scan new vehicles as they pass or sit parked.
Keep scanning until 100 unique vehicles are discovered.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Trigger Combat Focus while aiming, then drop five enemies before the focus bar runs out. Top the bar up first with food, drink or adrenaline, and pick a spot with a cluster of enemies such as a gang operation. A full-auto rifle helps a lot, and raising your Focus level through ranges, golf, pool and fishing makes the window longer.
steps: Raise your Focus level and fill the focus bar before the fight.
Find a group of at least five enemies at a gang operation.
Activate Combat Focus and take down five of them in one use.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal one of the big passenger planes docked at a departure terminal at Vice City International Airport, not one sitting on the open airfield. Board it, get to the cockpit, taxi it back to the runway and take off, then fly about a kilometre away from the airport. The plane at terminals E3 and E4 is the easiest to reach.
steps: Go to VCIA and reach the passenger plane docked at terminal E3 or E4.
Board the plane, enter the cockpit and taxi to the runway.
Take off and fly at least 1 km away from the airport.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Head to Mile Zero Air Station on the island at the south-west edge of the map and steal a military tank from the south of the base. Climb in and start shooting enemies until the trophy unlocks. Expect heavy resistance on the way in, so go in fast and armored.
steps: Travel to Mile Zero Air Station in the south-west of the map.
Enter the base and climb into a tank.
Fire the tank's cannon at enemies until the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs you own the Snap Gun, which silently picks alarmed back doors. Slip into a jewelry store through the back, find the note with the safe code, and loot the safe without setting off the alarm. Richardson Jewelry and Diamonds in Vice City is a good first target.
steps: Finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs to get the Snap Gun.
Enter a jewelry store through the back door using the Snap Gun.
Find the safe code note and loot the safe undetected.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Bank vault robberies open with the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is, where you tail a security van to a bank and slip in while the vault is open. After that, buy van tips from Yasmani for $10,000 a tip and repeat the trick. You need five vaults for this trophy and all eight for the 100% checklist, and every vault brings a four-star wanted level, so escape on a fast bike.
steps: Complete the Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is to unlock vault robberies.
Buy security van tips from Yasmani and follow the vans to banks.
Rob five bank vaults and escape the police each time.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: This one comes free with your first bank vault robbery, since tailing the armored truck to the bank counts as robbing it. If you want it sooner, block an armored truck near a bank, blow its back door with a sticky bomb, grab the cash and escape the heat radius. Either way, escape the red zone to make it pop.
steps: Tail an armored truck to a bank or stop one on the street.
Rob the truck and take the cash.
Escape the red heat radius until the trophy unlocks.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Unfog the entire map of Leonida and this trophy is yours. A plane is the fastest tool for the job: fly over every blacked-out patch until the whole map is revealed. Do it in one long sweep after the story and it will not take long.
steps: Get a plane after the story.
Fly over every fogged area of the map until it is revealed.
Check the map to confirm no blacked-out regions remain.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: There are nine gangs running 39 illegal operations across the state, and you need to rob at least one operation per gang. They show as yellow icons when you get close, and many are marked automatically as the story progresses. Track your per-gang progress under Progress, then Gangs, and finish all 39 anyway for the 100% checklist.
steps: Find illegal gang operations marked with yellow icons on the map.
Rob one operation belonging to each of the nine gangs.
Check Progress, then Gangs to see which gangs are still missing.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: This is one of the newly confirmed trophies, and its exact trigger is still being pinned down by the community. The description points to ordering a cocktail somewhere with a view on Ocean Beach, so visit the beachfront bars there and try ordering a drink. Check community guides for the confirmed spot before making a special trip.
steps: Head to Ocean Beach and look for a beachfront bar with a view.
Order a cocktail there.
Check the trophy list and community confirmations if it does not pop.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: This is one of the newly confirmed trophies, and its exact trigger is still being pinned down by the community. The description suggests driving a car out through a vehicle showroom's glass front, so try it at a dealership showroom. Confirm the working showroom in community guides before spending too long on attempts.
steps: Find a vehicle showroom with a glass front you can drive through.
Get a car inside the showroom, then smash out through the front.
Check the trophy list and community confirmations if it does not pop.

trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn is one of the gang operations, and this trophy asks you to steal all three key valuables inside: a luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on a table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway. Bring sticky bombs to blow the safe, then escape the police for the trophy to pop. If you miss an item during the optional mission, you can come back later once the robbery icon respawns.
steps: Go to Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn with sticky bombs.
Steal the luxury watch, the Gutterball shotgun and the safe contents.
Escape the police to unlock the trophy.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Work out at fitness clubs together, since training with your partner means both characters progress at once, and you can also work out at home after the story. Check each character's strength under Touchpad, then Jason and Lucia, to see how close you are.
steps: Unlock switching between both characters after Coffee Break.
Work out at fitness clubs with your partner alongside you.
Raise both characters to maximum strength at the same time.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile, from clean stealthy robberies to violent rampages, and the trophy pops at 500. Turn on criminal profile notifications in the settings so you can see each action register. Most players will reach this naturally while working on robberies and the 100% checklist, so do not grind it early.
steps: Turn on Criminal Profile notifications in Settings, then UI.
Play robberies and encounters normally so profile actions stack up.
Check the trophy counter and top it up to 500 if needed.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: This trophy's exact trigger is still unconfirmed, though early reports link it to the Payday Loans store from the prologue. The name hints at failing something once and succeeding on the second try. Keep an eye on community confirmations before going out of your way for it, and do not grind blindly at the store.
steps: Check the latest community findings on the Payday Loans connection.
Return to the Payday Loans store and try the suspected interaction.
Retry a second time if the first attempt does not trigger it.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: This is one of the newly confirmed trophies, and its exact trigger is still being pinned down by the community. Early reports link it to a UFO questline, so watch for strange lights and unexplained events while exploring Leonida at night. Check community guides for the confirmed steps once they are verified.
steps: Explore Leonida at night and watch for UFO-related events.
Follow any UFO questline markers that appear.
Check the trophy list and community confirmations for the verified trigger.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: This is one of the newly confirmed trophies, and its exact trigger is still being pinned down by the community. Early reports suggest knocking enemies over with a melee attack while riding a motorcycle, like a drive-by kick. Try that on slow-moving targets and check community guides for the confirmed method.
steps: Get on a motorcycle and ride toward enemies on foot.
Strike them with a melee attack while driving past.
Check the trophy list and community confirmations if it does not pop.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check you get the Dye Pack Jammer, which lets you launder marked bills from banks and payday loans through a fence. Yasmani in Vice City pays the best rates. The $250,000 total builds up across all your robberies, and a single bank vault can hand you up to $205,000, so this comes naturally with the robbery grind.
steps: Finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer.
Rob banks and payday loans to collect marked bills.
Deliver $250,000 in marked bills to a fence such as Yasmani.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across any shops in the game, and it all counts together. Guns, car mods and tattoos are the priciest, so they get you there fastest. You will chip away at this naturally while gearing up, so just keep shopping as you play.
steps: Buy gear, car mods, clothes or tattoos at any shops.
Prioritise expensive purchases such as guns and mods.
Keep spending until the $100,000 total is reached.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all eight purchasable garages through the Vice City Real Estate app on your phone, which unlocks after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver. Together they cost about $160,000, and the four story garages do not count. Robberies in Chapters 3 and 4 pay well, so fund the purchases from those.
steps: Unlock the Vice City Real Estate app after Daily Driver.
Earn money through robberies and other jobs.
Buy all eight purchasable garages through the app.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: The Scooter Bros app arrives on your phone after the Chapter 2 mission where you take a vehicle to Moses, and it lets you register stolen vehicles for delivery anywhere. You need enough garage space first, so buy garages through Little Boxes, then drive stolen cars to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose Respray and Register. Cheap cars and bikes keep the registration fees low.
steps: Unlock the Scooter Bros app and Moses after the Chapter 2 mission.
Buy garages so you have parking spots to register vehicles.
Register 10 vehicles through Moses or Pay 'n' Spray locations.
